what: Circle issues USDC, the second-largest dollar stablecoin. Each token is backed by dollars and short-term treasuries, and Circle earns the interest on those reserves.
customers: Crypto exchanges, payment companies, fintechs and traders who want dollars that move on a blockchain.
money: interest earned on the treasuries backing USDC
moat: USDC is the regulated stablecoin institutions choose, with reserves audited and held in treasuries, which matters to banks and regulators in a way its larger rival's do not.
risks: Revenue is interest income, so a fall in interest rates cuts it directly
Coinbase takes a large share of the reserve income under their distribution agreement
97% average upside in analyst targets signals wide disagreement about what this is worth
opportunities: Revenue grew from $1.5B to $2.7B in two years as USDC in circulation grew
American stablecoin legislation passed in 2025 gives regulated issuers a clear legal footing
watch: USDC in circulation and the share of reserve income kept after distribution costs.
